svg.title: Assigning work in a group chat (illustration)
svg.desc: Group chat illustration: a teammate @-mentions the bot with a code question and gets an answer at once. You @-mention it with a job and a verify command, and it hands the job to the project manager. About 40 minutes later it reports back: the service re-ran npm test and it passed, a draft pull request is open, and merging is your call. Names, repository and messages are made up.
